title: 第9章 结束第10章 搜刮
content_zh:
这猩红种子的能力简直逆天！
它不仅赋予了宿主强大的基础体能，还能能直接汲取敌人的生命，还能将汲取来的生命力即时转化为治疗宿主的能量！
只要敌人足够多，就能持续杀戮，他就能越战越强，伤口瞬间愈合，体力永不枯竭！
谁能扛得住这种无赖打法？
“哈哈哈哈！”
凯撒放声大笑，心中最后一丝顾虑烟消云散，眼神中的冰冷被一种狂热的战意取代。
怪物的攻击在凯撒身上，留下大量的伤口，但每一次受伤，猩红大剑都会及时地反馈回一股精纯的生命能量，伤口便以肉眼可见的速度愈合如初。
体力在杀戮中不仅没有消耗，反而因为生命力的不断补充而保持着旺盛的状态！
这种感觉太奇妙了，也太令人上瘾了！
“不能拖太久！”
一个冷静的念头在凯撒脑中浮现，猩红种子的力量绝非无限！
血肉之书上明确提到过随宿主强度而定，那必然存在时间限制。
如果不能在有效时间内解决所有敌人那结果必死无疑，还不知道这种子是否存在负面作用。
“得把它们全部引出来，一网打尽！”
凯撒眼中闪过一丝狠厉，他需要一个足够醒目、足够刺激的诱饵。
他猛地挥剑荡开身前的两只怪物，制造出一个短暂的空隙，同时抄起一把断裂的镰刀断柄，没有丝毫犹豫，狠狠朝着自己的胸膛划去！
“嗤——！”
锋利的锈铁割开了皮肉，一道深可见骨的狰狞伤口瞬间出现，鲜血汹涌而出。
“嗬嗬嗬——！
！”

整个怪物群彻底疯狂了！
它们的眼中红光暴涨，不顾一切地朝着鲜血气味的源头凯撒猛扑！
那些原本躲在阴影角落、倒塌房屋深处、甚至地窖里的怪物，也被这前所未有的血腥所吸引，纷纷嘶吼着爬了出来。
凯撒强忍着胸口的剧痛，爆发出极限速度，围绕着整个破败村落的边缘疯狂奔跑！
他专挑开阔地带和怪物可能藏匿的角落跑过。
每跑一步，胸口的鲜血就洒落一路，在尘土和粘液混合的地面上留下一条断断续续、刺目的猩红轨迹。
“上辈子倒是没有被人追过，这辈子倒是满足我的愿望了”
凯撒一边狂奔，胸口伤口因为猩红大剑正源源不断地将刚刚斩杀数十头怪物所汲取的庞大生命力注入他的体内。
绕着村子跑了大半圈，凯撒觉得吸引的差不多了，他的面前是汇聚而来的怪物海洋，从村子各个阴暗角落被鲜血吸引出来的怪物，加上之前未被消灭的，数量达到了惊人的地步！
目测之下，绝对接近两百之数！
整个村落，此刻已化作了真正的人间地狱。
“这应该就是全部了……”
凯撒舔了舔有些干裂的嘴唇，眼中没有丝毫恐惧，只有燃烧到极致的战意和一丝时间紧迫带来的焦灼，“时间紧，任务重！
两眼一闭就是干！”
“啊——！
content_en:
The ability of this scarlet seed is simply incredible!
It not only gives the host powerful basic physical energy, but can also directly absorb the enemy's life, and can also instantly convert the absorbed life force into energy to heal the host!
As long as there are enough enemies and he can continue to kill, he will become stronger as he fights, his wounds will heal instantly, and his physical strength will never run out!
Who can withstand such a rogue style of play?
"Hahahaha!"
Caesar laughed loudly, the last trace of concern in his heart disappeared, and the coldness in his eyes was replaced by a fanatical fighting spirit.
The monster's attack left a large number of wounds on Caesar's body, but every time he was injured, the scarlet sword would promptly feed back a stream of pure life energy, and the wounds would heal as before at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Not only is the physical strength not consumed during the killing, but it is maintained in a strong state due to the continuous replenishment of vitality!
This feeling is so amazing and so addictive!
"Can't wait too long!"
A calm thought emerged in Caesar's mind. The power of the scarlet seeds is by no means unlimited!
The Book of Flesh clearly mentioned that depending on the strength of the host, there must be a time limit.
If all enemies cannot be eliminated within the effective time, the result will be death. I don’t know if this method has any negative effects.
"We have to lure them all out and catch them all in one go!"
There was a fierce look in Caesar's eyes. He needed a bait that was eye-catching and exciting enough.
He swung his sword sharply to swipe away the two monsters in front of him, creating a short gap. At the same time, he picked up the broken handle of a broken sickle, and without any hesitation, slashed hard towards his chest!
"Tsk-!"
The sharp rusty iron cut open the flesh, and a hideous wound that was deep enough to reveal the bone appeared instantly, and blood surged out.
“Ho ho ho—!
! "
The whole group of monsters went completely crazy!
The red light in their eyes surged, and they pounced desperately towards Caesar, the source of the blood smell!
The monsters that were originally hiding in shadowed corners, deep in collapsed houses, and even in cellars were attracted by the unprecedented bloodshed and crawled out screaming.
Caesar endured the severe pain in his chest, burst out at extreme speed, and ran wildly around the edge of the entire ruined village!
He specializes in running through open areas and corners where monsters might hide.
With every step he ran, the blood on his chest spilled all the way, leaving an intermittent and dazzling scarlet trail on the ground mixed with dust and mucus.
"I was never chased by anyone in my previous life, but my wishes have been fulfilled in this life."
As Caesar ran wildly, the wound on his chest was because the scarlet sword was continuously injecting the huge life force that he had just killed dozens of monsters into his body.
After running around the village for more than half a circle, Caesar felt that he was almost attracted. In front of him was a sea of ​​monsters gathering. Monsters attracted by blood from all the dark corners of the village, plus those that had not been eliminated before, the number reached an astonishing level!
According to visual inspection, the number is definitely close to two hundred!
The entire village has now turned into a real hell on earth.
"This should be all..."
Caesar licked his chapped lips, there was no fear in his eyes, only the burning desire to fight and a hint of anxiety caused by the urgency of time, "Time is tight and the task is heavy!
Just close your eyes and do it! "
"Ah——!
